notes: Own-harness run through the harness's own engine with the observer wrapped around its default model runner.
Model route anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 resolves to the claude CLI under the local claude.ai login; per-call cost is not metered and is recorded as unknown.
llm_max_files bounds the files the harness sends to the model; qmd is absent on this machine so the harness reports a lite runtime profile.
Content-mode traces stay local; they contain the source shipped to the model.
